newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue to sink.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue to sink.

text.p: A slowdown in feed consumption by livestock kept millfeed prices under pressure at several locations, millfeed dealers said.

Frigid cold blanketing much of the central U.S. has cattle huddled away from feedbunks thus reducing feed intake, livestock and feed sources said. Also, snow-covered roads from Missouri to North Dakota and from Indiana to Nebraska, has halted truck shipments in many areas.
"You can't deliver it...That's probably one reason for it (lower prices)," said a Minnesota millfeed dealer.
"We've got (feed) ingredients that cannot get there," said an Indiana dealer. "I think overall, the impact will be less (feed usage) rather than more."
